title: Night Buses Return
text:
After a three-year break, night buses (1) to Bangkok's streets last week. The service, (2) runs from midnight to 5 a.m., connects the city center with six suburbs. Each bus (3) a driver and a security guard. The project was started (4) many night-shift workers complained that taxis were too expensive. "Before, I spent half of my salary (5) taxis," said one hospital cleaner. "Now I pay only 20 baht."
So far, passenger numbers have been higher than (6) the city expected. However, some residents along the routes say the buses are too noisy. The city has promised to use electric buses, (7) are much quieter, by next year. If the service (8) popular, more routes will be added. Experts say good public transport at night is important (9) a city's economy, as many businesses depend on workers (10) start early or finish late.

items.stem: (1) After a three-year break, night buses ___ to Bangkok's streets last week.
why_wrong: return เป็นปัจจุบัน
have returned ไม่ใช้กับ last week
are returning ไม่ใช้กับ last week
items.explanation_th: last week = อดีต → returned

items.stem: (2) The service, ___ runs from midnight to 5 a.m., connects the city center with six suburbs.
why_wrong: หลัง comma ใช้ that ไม่ได้
who ใช้กับคน
where ต้องมีประโยคครบตาม
items.explanation_th: ขยาย The service หลัง comma → which

items.stem: (3) Each bus ___ a driver and a security guard.
why_wrong: have ใช้กับพหูพจน์
is having ผิดความหมาย
are ผิด
items.explanation_th: Each bus (เอกพจน์) → has

items.stem: (4) The project was started ___ many night-shift workers complained that taxis were too expensive.
why_wrong: although ไม่สมเหตุผล
so ทำให้กลับเหตุผล
unless ไม่สมเหตุผล
items.explanation_th: เริ่มโครงการเพราะคนบ่นเรื่องแท็กซี่แพง → "because"

items.stem: (5) "Before, I spent half of my salary ___ taxis,"
why_wrong: spend for ไม่ใช่รูปมาตรฐาน
spend in ผิด
spend at ผิด (at ใช้กับสถานที่)
items.explanation_th: spend money on + สิ่ง

items.stem: (6) So far, passenger numbers have been higher than ___ the city expected.
why_wrong: than that the city expected ผิด
which ต้องมีคำนาม
than as ผิด
items.explanation_th: higher than what the city expected = สูงกว่าที่เมืองคาด (what = สิ่งที่)

items.stem: (7) The city has promised to use electric buses, ___ are much quieter, by next year.
why_wrong: หลัง comma ใช้ that ไม่ได้
what ไม่ขยายคำนาม
who ใช้กับคน
items.explanation_th: ขยาย electric buses หลัง comma → which

items.stem: (8) If the service ___ popular, more routes will be added.
why_wrong: หลัง if ไม่ใช้ will
remained ใช้กับ would
หลัง if ไม่ใช้ would
items.explanation_th: If แบบที่ 1 → remains

items.stem: (9) Experts say good public transport at night is important ___ a city's economy, as many businesses depend on workers … start early or finish late.
why_wrong: important at ผิด
important by ผิด
important on ผิด
items.explanation_th: important for + สิ่ง = สำคัญต่อ…

items.stem: (10) Experts say good public transport at night is important … a city's economy, as many businesses depend on workers ___ start early or finish late.
why_wrong: which ใช้กับสิ่ง
whose ต้องตามด้วยคำนาม
where ใช้กับสถานที่
items.explanation_th: workers (คน) + ประธานของ start → who
